sources.title: Nimbus Cartography Collective: A Brief History

claims.text: The Nimbus Cartography Collective was founded in 2011.

citations.quote: The Nimbus Cartography Collective was founded in 2011 by four cartographers working out of a shared studio in Rotterdam.

claims.text: Nimbus began operations in early 2012, according to the organisation's own first annual report.
